findings: Generated-source preflight resolves both prior failures: floor/wall friction is restored to 0.50/0.35, while 1.2/1.0 is confined to visibly distinct grasp tabs and verified through native composed-material readback.

Contact and stationarity durations are explicitly identified as 20 Hz sampled observations. The report states they do not establish continuous 240 Hz behavior and lists continuous 240 Hz dwell as unqualified.
The planned program uses native rigid-body, joint, contact, support, mass/inertia, camera, and material observations; it does not claim full loaded-scene qualification or future native results.
Workforce/category importance and full loaded media-separation physics remain honestly unresolved, as permitted for this prototype preflight stage.
